title: German Scientists Seek Public’s Help to Count Insects This Summer (2/2)
titleZh: 德國科學家今夏邀請民眾一起數昆蟲 (2/2)
summaryZh: 德國團隊號召民眾參與昆蟲普查，了解昆蟲數量下降的情況。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Science & Technology

sentences.text: In recent years, for example, scientists have expressed concerns about what appears to be a decrease in the bee population worldwide.
sentences.zh: 舉例來說，近幾年科學家很擔心全球蜜蜂的數量似乎正在減少。

sentences.text: The drop in some kinds of insects is often blamed on human causes, including chemicals and damage to the environment.
sentences.zh: 某些昆蟲數量下降，常被歸咎於人為因素，包括化學藥劑和環境破壞。

sentences.text: Breitkreutz said, the Insect Count Project helps the scientists, and it also helps people respect the role insects play in their daily lives.
sentences.zh: Breitkreutz 說，昆蟲普查計畫不只幫了科學家，也讓大家更重視昆蟲在日常生活中扮演的角色。

sentences.text: It's very important for us to show people how important, great, and interesting insects are, she said.
sentences.zh: 她說，讓大家看見昆蟲有多重要、多了不起、多有趣，對我們來說非常重要。

sentences.text: Breitkreutz said, some people lack knowledge of what is crawling around outside.
sentences.zh: Breitkreutz 說，有些人其實不太清楚外面爬來爬去的到底是什麼。

sentences.text: The first insect count is happening until June 9th, and the next one is from August 2nd to 11th.
sentences.zh: 第一次昆蟲普查進行到六月九日，下一次則是八月二日到十一日。

sentences.text: The NABU provides a document to fill out, and an app for the citizen scientists to report their findings.
sentences.zh: NABU 提供一份表格，還有一款應用程式，讓公民科學家回報他們的觀察結果。
